findings.quote: Descriptor swapWrap `rawdata.[-17:]` uses `"token": "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2"`. CommonUtils._WETH is 0xbb4CdB9C… on chain 56, 0x4200…0006 on 10/130/8453, 0x0d500B1d… on 137, 0x82aF4944… on 42161, and so on.
